sentences.text: Sprocket-AD achieves a higher average event-F1 (78.4%) than Lanyard-TS (77.2%) across the five benchmarks, with higher event-F1 on four benchmarks (Rookhaven-Server 88.7 vs 86.9, Mallowmere-Water 74.2 vs 72.8, Tinderbox-HVAC 69.5 vs 67.1, Whitlow-Rail 81.3 vs 80.6) and equal event-F1 on Quayside-Grid v2 (78.4 vs 78.4).

Sprocket-AD also shows lower median detection delay than Lanyard-TS on three benchmarks (Rookhaven-Server 12 vs 15, Quayside-Grid v2 8 vs 9, Whitlow-Rail 17 vs 21) but higher delay on two (Mallowmere-Water 30 vs 26, Tinderbox-HVAC 41 vs 39).

Ablation results indicate that both the frequency branch and adaptive thresholds contribute to Sprocket-AD's accuracy, as the full model (78.4% average event-F1) outperforms variants without the frequency branch (76.9%), without adaptive thresholds (77.5%), and without both (75.8%).

Sprocket-AD is more parameter-efficient (3.2M vs 5.8M parameters) and faster in training (14 vs 22 min) and inference (0.9 vs 1.4 ms per window) than Lanyard-TS, though Dunmore-Iso is faster in training (2 min) and inference (0.3 ms) with parameters not reported.
